scope: Read cached already-qualified primary header source only; no build/native/source/coordinate/area/model execution. APIs/behavior are specific to these pinned cached headers, not a claim about other library versions.
facts: AssemblerConfig documents that multipolygon roles are ignored during construction; check_roles=true checks/reports them only afterward. Strict source-role acceptance must be explicit.
ignore_invalid_locations defaults false and must stay false; its comment warns enabling it can produce geometrically valid but wrong areas.
create_empty_areas defaults true, preserving invalid objects for detection rather than silently discarding.
Assembler::operator()(Way) reports different first/last native IDs but continues area construction, so its success alone does not prove native-ID closure.
NodeRefSegment comparison/equality uses locations, so this kernel cannot replace a native-ID endpoint topology proof.
proposedUse: First establish complete source membership/native-ID closed chains; keep open/branch/touch/duplicate/short cases explicit. If reusing the cached kernel afterward, separately audit source roles, source-edge coverage, holes/containment/self-intersections and every reported repair/problem. Test distinct native IDs at identical coordinates and missing geometry before any country polygon producer. No area/routing/app admission follows from this review.
